subject: Welcome to Redwood — pick a quick demo time
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@velosystems.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:12:22 -0700
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick demo link inside

Hi Samira,

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood Inference — welcome! I wanted to send a short note with a couple of ways to get a 30-minute product walkthrough on the calendar:

- Book a slot that's convenient: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?invite=velosys
- If you'd rather tell me availability, reply with 2–3 windows this week and we’ll pick one.

Quick helpful notes:
- We keep demos focused on your use case (latency/cost profile + deployment mode). If you want, tell me whether you care most about hosted API, Dedicated capacity, or private deployment.
- I’ll include an engineer on the call for technical Q&A (cc: Vivek).

If you prefer us to send a calendar invite directly, reply with preferred times and timezone.

Attachments: provisioning details (quick-demo-agenda.md) and a short security primer (security-one-pager.pdf).

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Sales Development | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
https://www.redwood.ai
From: Samira Khan <samira@velosystems.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:37:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — quick demo link inside

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — booked via Calendly for Tuesday 9/19 at 11:00am PT. That time should work. A couple of quick context items:

- We'll want to cover integration with our data plane (S3 + internal VPC endpoints) and how Redwood handles KV cache across bursts.
- Attendees: me (Head of Data Platform) and our infra lead, Miguel Rivera (miguel@velosystems.com).

Can you confirm whether the demo will show a hosted API path, or also run through Dedicated/Private options?

Thanks,
Samira

Hi Samira — great, thanks for booking. Confirming the calendar entry for Tue 19 Sep, 11:00am PT (I see your booking).

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5 min: intros and goals (you + Miguel)
- 5–15 min: demo — hosted API happy-path and latency/cost profile
- 15–25 min: discuss Dedicated/Private options and security/architecture for VPC
- 25–30 min: next steps / evaluation checklist

Vivek (cc) will join to cover architecture and any technical integration concerns. Marissa (cc) is our customer success lead and will pick up rollout steps after the demo.

I've attached the agenda and a one-pager on security controls for quick context. If you want us to focus more on Private deployment/air-gapped options, let me know and we'll tailor the demo.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=velosys-demo-20280919-1100
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,

Samira — Vivek here from the Redwood platform team. Quick note to say I’ll be on the call next Tuesday and I’ve pulled a short checklist so we can be efficient:

1) Access: can you confirm if Miguel will have access to your S3 bucket or if we should run a sandbox?
2) Network: are there egress rules we should know about for a Private deployment review?
3) Data retention: do you have a minimum retention/SOC2 requirement we should be aware of ahead of time?

If you prefer, reply in-thread or send any docs to infra@velosystems.com.

Thanks — see you Tuesday.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
